tenderSchedule.title: PROCUREMENT OF CITRIC ACID
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.
The intending bidder shall be OEM/OES/Authorized dealer/Supplier of Citric Acid to any Power plant/Process industries/Offices. The agency should furnish documentary proof.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.6.20 lakhs for any two years in preceding five financial years. As a proof, the bidder should upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have supplied Citric Acid to any Power plant/Process industries. As a proof PO copy shall be furnished with quantity 4.5MT or above in a single purchase order in any one year during preceding five financial years (2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).
Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed.
